title: How to purchase on LoloBuy?
claims: Link or manual ordering; item and domestic delivery first, international parcel later.

title: Standard inspection service
claims: Standard inspection checks visible attributes; no-inspection and specialist/sealed-goods exclusions apply.

title: Size Reference
claims: Store measurements can differ; reference sizing is not a product-specific fit guarantee.

title: Free Storage Period
claims: Dedicated storage page states 180 days for ordinary goods and separate abnormal-parcel rules.

title: Package removal
claims: Optional package removal preserves necessary protective packaging.

title: The estimated weight and real weight
claims: Final packed dimensions and weight can change freight; volumetric billing is route dependent.

title: Status of the Shopping Agent Orders
claims: Received precedes completed inspection; In Stock means stored inventory; parcel stages are separate.

title: Can the Shopping Agent orders be cancelled or refunded?
claims: Cancellation and refund depend on order stage and seller agreement.

title: How to apply for parcel after-sales
claims: Parcel after-sales uses a parcel-specific application with product and package evidence; stated time limits conflict.

title: Standard photo service
claims: Secondary Quality Inspection is offered for stored goods whose inspection was previously skipped.

title: Shopping Agent Service
claims: Service overview describes additional QC photos on request, but numbers differ from standard inspection.

title: Can I modify my order after the order has been submitted?
claims: Before dispatch changes are negotiated; after dispatch return and a new order may be needed.

title: What does "Pending for confirmation" means and what do I do?
claims: Pending for Confirmation requires an answer to the order message.

title: How to reply if Shopping Agent order is ‘Pending for Confirmatio
claims: Purchased-order and warehouse confirmations are handled in different account sections.

title: How LoloBuy Collects Supplemental Payments for Parcels
claims: Initial freight is estimated; actual freight can require a supplemental payment or refund.

title: Shall I just pay for one delivery fee if I bought several items
claims: Same-seller items checked out together can share domestic freight; heavy orders may require a balance.

title: What do I do if the item has a discounted price?
claims: Real seller offers should be described in remarks for agent verification.

title: Terms of Promised Returns with no reasons
claims: Eligible returns have a stated 120-hour window from the hour after Stocked in, subject to conditions.

title: Return the Product
claims: Approved refunds generally go to account balance; a narrow PayPal exception is not general payment-method evidence.

title: Guide to 1688 Shopping Agent Service
claims: 1688 orders require seller minimums and have separate quantity/inspection considerations.

title: LoloBuy shipping estimator
claims: Use destination, weight, dimensions and goods inputs for a current estimate; no fixed freight tariff is claimed.
